messages:
vivian: Heads-up: after today's firewall tighten I see GPU joins failing in us-east-2 (lots of 403s to keystore).
samir: confirmed. Node agent log: `GET https://keystore.internal/v1/session -> 403`.
ops-bot: Security Change: egress-policy/v1 applied to vpc-prod-llm by security-runner. Default deny, allowlist = {10.0.0.0/16, 52.120.0.0/14}.
vivian: that allowlist omits keystore subnet 10.46.200.0/24 and allocator endpoints.
chris.sre: impact: warm-pool down ~35% in two AZs, provisioning timeouts, autoscaler trimming capacity.
samir: mitigation idea: append keystore CIDR to allowlist and do a canary rollout to remaining zones.
security-runner: applied update: added 10.46.200.0/24 to egress allowlist. rule id egress-append-331.
vivian: post-change smoke: `curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" https://keystore.internal/v1/ping` -> 200 from a recovered node.
chris.sre: warm-pool rebuilding, Ready count recovering; provisioning errors dropping.
vivian: root cause: rollout lacked reference to critical infra CIDRs. Action: create ENG-INF-301 to build an "egress service registry" and wire it into change preflight checks.
ops-bot: Ticket ENG-INF-301 created; owner samir.
vivian: finance FYI: please estimate extra CPU fallback + NAT egress for ~20m impact window. I'll file the postmortem once we have numbers.
